coding.note: The PDF text has two interleaved columns, so I chose short quotes that stay inside one column. Ablations: the partial-rotary choice (25% of dimensions) rests on 'initial experiments' that are only linked as external W&B reports. The parallel-attention claim rests on loss curves from Mesh Transformer JAX, reported only in prose. Neither has a controlled table in the paper, so both are coded NO; PARTIAL could also be argued for each. Seeds: the error bars are evaluation standard errors, not variation across training runs, so seeds is NR. Tokens: batch size (~3.15M tokens) and step count (150k) are stated, which implies ~470B tokens. No total is stated outright, so I coded N to stay conservative. Comparators: most baselines were run by the authors in the EleutherAI eval harness. The exception is GPT-3's five-shot MMLU scores, copied from Hendrycks et al., so rerun and scores_copied are both MIXED. Compute: the paper gives 1830 hours on 96 A100 GPUs (12 nodes × 8) and energy use in MWh.
